step1_analysis.description: A single-balanced mixer (XM3, XM5) acting as a phase detector, accompanied by dummy transistor branches (XM1/6, XM2, XM4) to provide symmetric capacitive loading to the input ports. This symmetric loading is critical in oscillator injection-locking schemes to prevent phase errors.

paper_reference.title: An Injection-Locking Scheme for Precision Quadrature Generation

conversion_gain.description: Ratio of the IF output amplitude to the RF input amplitude.

paper_reported.value: 45 dB (likely for the entire system including limiting amplifiers)

sky130_expected.calculation: gm ~ 2mS for W/L=5/0.5 at 1mA. With 1k load, gain ~ (2/pi) * gm * Rload ~ 1.2 V/V ~ 1.5 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: A passive-like single-balanced mixer with moderate load resistors typically has a conversion gain around 0 dB. The 45 dB reported in the paper includes high-gain limiting amplifiers.

phase_detector_gain.description: The change in DC output voltage per radian of phase difference between the two inputs.

sky130_expected.calculation: Kpd = V_p2p / (2*pi). If V_p2p is ~0.8V, Kpd ~ 0.8 / 6.28 ~ 0.13 V/rad.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Derived from the expected IF peak-to-peak voltage swing divided by 2*pi.

power_consumption.description: Total DC power dissipation of the phase detector core.

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming ~1mA per branch and 4 active branches (including dummies), total current ~4mA. Power = 4mA * 1.8V = 7.2mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Adjusted for SKY130 1.8V supply and typical bias currents for 5um/0.5um devices.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis applying 2.7 GHz and 2.6 GHz signals to the inputs to measure the 100 MHz IF beat signal. This extracts the conversion gain, phase detector gain, and power consumption.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Phase Detector / Mixer
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N1 N14 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N16 N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N3 N14 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N8 N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N12 N0 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N11 N14 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}

* Supplies and Loads
VDD VDD 0 1.8
R11 N11 VDD 1k
R12 N12 VDD 1k
R16 N16 VDD 1k
R8 N8 VDD 1k

* IF Filter Capacitors (Pole at ~160 MHz to filter out 2.7 GHz RF ripple)
C11 N11 0 1p
C12 N12 0 1p
C16 N16 0 1p
C8 N8 0 1p

* Inputs (LO at 2.7 GHz, RF at 2.6 GHz to generate 100 MHz IF)
VLO N14 0 DC 0.9 SIN(0.9 0.4 2.7G)
VRF N0 0 DC 0.9 SIN(0.9 0.4 2.6G)

.control
  * Transient analysis for mixing
  tran 10p 50n
  
  * Measure power
  meas tran i_vdd avg i(VDD) from=20n to=50n
  let power = -i_vdd * 1.8
  print power
  
  * Measure IF amplitude at N12 (100 MHz IF)
  meas tran v_max max v(N12) from=20n to=50n
  meas tran v_min min v(N12) from=20n to=50n
  let v_p2p = v_max - v_min
  let if_amp = v_p2p / 2
  let rf_amp = 0.4
  
  * Conversion Gain
  let conversion_gain = if_amp / rf_amp
  let cg_db = 20 * log10(conversion_gain)
  print cg_db
  
  * Phase Detector Gain (Kpd = V_p2p / 2*pi)
  let kpd = v_p2p / 6.2831853
  print kpd
  
  quit
.endc
.end
